_text: [fast-paced, energetic storyteller] You're robbing a hundred-million-dollar vault... with hairspray. [mischievous] And the only thing that can stop you... is a *sandwich*. [excited] It's the biggest diamond heist in history, and you're running it like it's G-T-A. [dramatic] Ten layers of security: heat sensors, radar, magnets on the *door*. [amused] And a lock with a hundred million combinations. One for every dollar. [playful] So first, like every game, you grind two years of setup missions. [excited] Mission one: a suit, a tiny magnifying glass, and the most serious face in *Belgium*. [mischievous] Then you rent an office upstairs as a dealer. It comes with a box in the *vault*. [playful] So you visit. Day one, the guard stares. Day ten, he nods. Day five hundred, he doesn't even look up. [building excitement] Mission two: the crew. The Genius does alarms. The Monster picks locks. The King of Keys copies any *key*. [amused, deadpan] And Speedy, your best friend... panics at *pigeons*.
